path: lvp_pipeline.c277-308 compile_spirv calls vk_pipeline_shader_stage_to_nir; vk_pipeline.c180-185 calls vk_spirv_to_nir.
vtn_cfg.c327-328 imports SPIR-V Inline/DontInline into NIR function flags.
vk_nir.c165-172 unconditionally lowers local initializers/returns, runs nir_inline_functions, then removes non-entrypoints.

nir_functions.c224-230 only permits retained driver functions for MESA_SHADER_KERNEL. Ordinary Vulkan MESA_SHADER_COMPUTE does not take that exemption;233-248 recursively expands every defined direct callee without checking dont_inline.

lvp_pipeline.c579-584 passes resulting compute NIR to create_compute_state; lp_state_cs.c467-569 can emit separate LLVM helpers and lp_bld_nir_soa.c2625-2632 emits LLVM calls, but ordinary Vulkan frontend has already eliminated these source boundaries.
conclusion: Slang -O0 and SPIR-V DontInline cannot preserve arithmetic reuse as ordinary Vulkan compute LLVM calls on this upstream path. Gallivm generic function support/OpenCL kernel exemption is not Vulkan compute authority. Stop this hypothesis before any patch/compiler/provider workload; original science/benefit/scene gates unchanged.
